description: RFC 3339 §5.6 requires the colon and the minutes in a numeric time-numoffset for date-time (ajv-formats#117, #104). This supersedes the date-time cases from #1061 below, which were only ever valid under the non-normative ISO 8601 Appendix A grammar; see the iso-date-time block further down for those.

tests.description: invalid: numeric offset missing the minutes component
invalid: numeric offset missing the minutes component (negative)
invalid: numeric offset missing the colon separator
invalid: numeric offset missing the colon separator (negative)
invalid: malformed three digit offset without colon
invalid: malformed three digit offset without colon (negative)
valid: fully-formed numeric offset with colon and minutes

This supersedes the time cases from #1061 below, which were only ever valid under the non-normative ISO 8601 Appendix A grammar; see the iso-time block further down for those.

valid: fully-formed numeric offset with colon and minutes
